pluginDescription: Independently toggleable desktop and mobile enhancements for SiYuan; every setting item can be enabled, disabled or hidden on its own.
panel.none: No setting item is visible right now. Check feature-control.json at the repository root.
panel.readonlyTip: SiYuan is in read-only or publish mode, so settings cannot be saved.
dialog.discardText: You have unsaved changes. Closing now discards them.
dev.logLimitTip: Maximum number of entries printed at once.
dev.debugLogTip: Print extra diagnostics to the console while the plugin runs.
feature.functionDemo.name: Example: plugin command
feature.functionDemo.desc: Registers a plugin command and reacts to this panel's settings; verifies the config file, the save flow and cleanup.
feature.uiDemo.name: Example: injected CSS
feature.uiDemo.desc: Injects a namespaced stylesheet without touching core DOM; verifies reversible, CSS-based interface features.
feature.devDemo.name: Example: developer logging
feature.devDemo.desc: Diagnostics for development: logging switches and a registry snapshot on every config change.
